# MoveSelection&lt;TPixel&gt;

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class MoveSelection<TPixel> : RegionEditCommand<TPixel>
```

Moves a rectangular selection by (dx, dy) on a single flat raster: the source area is cleared to transparent and its pixels are re-stamped at the shifted position. Later writes win, so a pixel that is both cleared and re-stamped ends up stamped.

**Type parameters**

- `TPixel` - The pixel the target surface stores.

## Remarks

The re-stamped pixels are copied from the surface, so they arrive carrying whatever alpha they already had — an imported soft edge included. Under [`OpacityLock.Locked`](Nfty.Core.Editing.OpacityLock.md#f-locked) the base snaps them like any other painted pixel: moving a soft-edged sprite hardens its edge, which is the lock doing what it says rather than a gap in it.

Moves a rectangular selection, clearing what it left behind.

**Parameters**

- `source` (`PixelRect`) - The region to move.
- `dx` (`int`) - Horizontal offset in pixels.
- `dy` (`int`) - Vertical offset in pixels.
- `opacity` (`OpacityLock`) - Whether partial alpha is admitted on the moved pixels; locked by default.
